variables.name: PASS_MAX_DAYS
variables.description: Maximum password age in days. The check fails above this.

variables.name: PASS_MIN_DAYS
variables.description: Minimum days between password changes. The check fails below this.

variables.name: PASS_WARN_AGE
variables.description: Days of warning before a password expires. The check fails below this.

variables.name: ENCRYPT_METHOD
variables.description: Comma-separated ENCRYPT_METHOD values accepted in /etc/login.defs.

variables.name: INACTIVE_DAYS
variables.description: Days before an inactive password is locked. The check fails above this.

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: Required default umask. profile.d must set this value. login.defs and the root shell must be this strict or stricter.

variables.name: TMOUT
variables.description: Maximum interactive shell TMOUT in seconds. The check fails when no TMOUT is inside 1 and this value.

variables.name: FAILLOCK_DENY
variables.description: Maximum failed-login attempts before faillock locks the account. The check fails outside 1 and this value.

variables.name: FAILLOCK_UNLOCK_TIME
variables.description: Minimum faillock unlock_time in seconds. 0 (lock until an administrator unlocks) still passes.

variables.name: PASSWORD_MINLEN
variables.description: Minimum pwquality minlen. The check fails below this.

variables.name: PASSWORD_REMEMBER
variables.description: Minimum pwhistory remember count. The check fails below this.

variables.name: SUDO_TIMESTAMP_TIMEOUT
variables.description: Maximum sudo timestamp_timeout in minutes. The check fails above this. A missing sudo timeout still passes.

variables.name: CLIENT_ALIVE_INTERVAL
variables.description: Maximum sshd ClientAliveInterval in seconds. 0 fails. Set 300 to require a short idle timeout. ClientAliveCountMax must still be at least 1.

variables.name: LOGIN_GRACE_TIME
variables.description: Maximum sshd LoginGraceTime in seconds. The check fails outside 1 and this value.

variables.name: SSH_LOG_LEVEL
variables.description: Comma-separated sshd LogLevel values that pass.

variables.name: MAX_AUTH_TRIES
variables.description: Maximum sshd MaxAuthTries. The check fails outside 1 and this value.

variables.name: MAX_STARTUPS
variables.description: Maximum sshd MaxStartups as start:rate:full. Each field on the host must be at or below the matching field.

variables.name: MAX_SESSIONS
variables.description: Maximum sshd MaxSessions. The check fails outside 1 and this value.

variables.name: SSH_PERMIT_ROOT
variables.description: Comma-separated sshd PermitRootLogin values that pass.

variables.name: SELINUX_POLICY

variables.name: SELINUX_MODE
